newsitem.title: USA: AMEX to trade Parexel options on Feb 18.
newsitem.headline: AMEX to trade Parexel options on Feb 18.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange said Wednesday it would trade options on Parexel International Corp on February 18.
The options would open with strike prices of 60, 65 and 70, with position limits of 4,500 contracts. Initial expirations would be in March, April, June and September.
Shares of the clinical research and development services company were up 1/4 at 63-1/2 Wednesday morning.
J. Streicher & Co has been named the specialist unit.
